alt: A short film with no voice. A night window with stars and a thin moon. A small light-blue block figure with doorway legs and white eyes sits on the sill, shivering. A gold figure carrying a folded blanket on its head walks over, sits beside it, and the blanket slides over both of them, eyes above the edge. The shivering stops. A star crosses and both look up. The text on screen: Room for two. The last card reads Closer to yourself.
